title: Revisiting Chebyshev Polynomial and Anisotropic RBF Models for Tabular Regression
abstract: arXiv:2602.22422v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Smooth-basis models such as Chebyshev polynomial regressors and radial basis function (RBF) networks are well established in numerical analysis. Their continuously differentiable prediction surfaces suit surrogate optimisation, sensitivity analysis, and other settings where the response varies gradually with inputs. Despite these properties, smooth models seldom appear in tabular regression, where tree ensembles dominate. We ask whether they can compete, benchmarking models across 55 regression datasets organised by application domain.   We develop an anisotropic RBF network with data-driven centre placement and gradient-based width optimisation, a ridge-regularised Chebyshev polynomial regressor, and a smooth-tree hybrid (Chebyshev model tree), with all three released as scikit-learn-compatible packages. translated_title: 重新审视切比雪夫多项式与各向异性RBF模型在表格回归中的应用
translated_abstract: 平滑基模型，如切比雪夫多项式回归器和径向基函数（RBF）网络，在数值分析领域早已得到充分确立。其连续可微的预测曲面非常适用于代理优化、敏感性分析以及其他响应随输入平缓变化的场景。尽管具备这些特性，平滑模型却很少出现在表格回归任务中，而该领域目前由树集成模型主导。我们探究了平滑模型能否与树集成模型一较高下，并在按应用领域组织的55个回归数据集上进行了基准测试。我们开发了一种采用数据驱动中心布置与基于梯度宽度优化的各向异性RBF网络、一种岭正则化的切比雪夫多项式回归器，以及一种平滑树混合模型（切比雪夫模型树），这三者均以兼容scikit-learn的软件包形式发布。我们将这些模型与树集成模型、基于分箱的加性模型、预训练transformer以及标准基线进行基准对比评估。
tldr: 本文开发了三种平滑基回归模型（各向异性RBF网络、岭正则化切比雪夫多项式回归器和切比雪夫模型树）并以scikit-learn兼容软件包发布，通过在55个回归数据集上与树集成等模型进行基准测试，探讨了平滑模型在表格回归领域的竞争力。
en_tdlr: This paper develops three smooth-basis regression models (an anisotropic RBF network, a ridge-regularized Chebyshev polynomial regressor, and a Chebyshev model tree) released as scikit-learn-compatible packages, benchmarking them against tree ensembles and other baselines across 55 regression datasets to assess whether smooth models can compete in tabular regression.
